## Welcome
* Join us for a behind-the-scenes look at the tutorial slides
* All the features shown in these slides came up in the tutorial slides throughout this course
* You might not have realised at the time, but they were all made in Quarto - now you can do this too!

## This is a content slide
Take a look at the code - we've used two hash symbols.

## Bullet points
* To create bullet points
* Use an asterisk (*) at the beginning of each line

## Present information across columns
::::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
* This is column 1
* Width is set to 50%

:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
* This is column 2
* Width is also set to 50%

:::
:::::

## Present information across columns

⚠️ Columns use **fenced divs** (`:::`). Watch out for any warnings or errors related to these!

## Let's add an image!

You'll recognise this one:

![](images/Week1_checkin.jpg){fig-align="center"}

## Add a link

[Here's a link to the R Graph Gallery](https://r-graph-gallery.com)


## Did you know?❓

**You can add emojis for added fun!** 🎵🥁🎸🎺

(but make sure this is appropriate for your audience)



# We can have headings at different levels

## This is a level 2 heading (##)
* With some text underneath

### This is a level 3 heading (###)
* See?

## Use Markdown for formatting
* For example, you can make some words **bold**
* Use formatting for **visual effect** ✨


## `Backticks` are useful for presenting code
For example, if you were to mention the `{ggplot2}` package, you might use backticks to make it visually distinct.


## Call-out boxes

Call-out boxes (>) can be a useful design choice for your slides

> They even work in Whatsapp - try it!

## Tweak the settings for individual slides {transition="none"}
* Check the settings for this slide
* Did you notice that there was no transition?


## This slide reveals the bullet points all at once
::: {.nonincremental}

* Bullet 1
* Bullet 2
* Bullet 3

:::

## Here, the font size is smaller {.smaller}

But don't put TOO much text on a slide - it still needs to be readable.


## Let's explore the YAML
First, find the **YAML** at the top of this Quarto document.

## Let's explore the YAML

The YAML for these slides looks like this:

````yaml
title: "Template Slides"
subtitle: "An example of how to make slides in Quarto"
author: IDHSC Course Team
format:
  revealjs: 
    theme: dracula
    slide-number: c/t
    incremental: true
    transition: slide
    transition-speed: slow
    embed-resources: true 
    logo: images/logo.png
    footer: "[Course GitHub Repo](https://github.com/TeachHealthData/Intro-DSHSC-26)"
    title-slide-attributes:
     data-background-image: images/NewCollege.jpg
     data-background-size: contain
     data-background-opacity: "0.4"
````

## Now change the theme

The current theme is `dracula`. Try changing it to `solarized` or [another theme of your choice](https://quarto.org/docs/presentations/revealjs/themes.html).

````{.yaml code-line-numbers="6"}
title: "Template Slides"
subtitle: "An example of how to make slides in Quarto"
author: IDHSC Course Team
format:
  revealjs: 
    theme: dracula
    slide-number: c/t
    incremental: true
    transition: slide
    transition-speed: slow
    embed-resources: true 
    logo: images/logo.png
    footer: "[Course GitHub Repo](https://github.com/TeachHealthData/Intro-DSHSC-26)"
    title-slide-attributes:
     data-background-image: images/NewCollege.jpg
     data-background-size: contain
     data-background-opacity: "0.4"
````


## You can change slide transitions too

[Click here for the Quarto documentation](https://quarto.org/docs/presentations/revealjs/advanced.html)


````{.yaml code-line-numbers="9,10"}
title: "Template Slides"
subtitle: "An example of how to make slides in Quarto"
author: IDHSC Course Team
format:

    theme: dracula
    slide-number: c/t
    incremental: true
    transition: slide
    transition-speed: slow
    embed-resources: true 
    logo: images/logo.png

    title-slide-attributes:
     data-background-image: images/NewCollege.jpg
     data-background-size: contain
     data-background-opacity: "0.4"
````
